families.special_rules: A validated cmd.docker.compose.scenario.delete removes the scenario from the exact Project’s current scenario list, retaining the original ID and source refs in history. Existing validation must succeed; deletion is not compose down and never claims containers stopped.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: Use one valid Project scenario with resolved config, validated service/profile/env references and the original edited result; no other scenario changes.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

families.special_rules: A validated cmd.docker.compose.scenario.edit commits an actual change of one existing scenario against its original currentness. An unchanged edit emits nothing. Stale fingerprints must pass the existing validation/repair path before edit is enabled.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: Use one valid Project scenario with resolved config, validated service/profile/env references and the original run result; no other scenario changes.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

families.special_rules: cmd.docker.compose.scenario.run records the original owner-confirmed launch/run activity receipt for the exact validated scenario and compose config-hash. Dispatch acceptance alone is insufficient; the run receipt proves the launch, never health, test pass or terminal success. Restart reads this receipt and never reruns Compose.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: Use one valid Project scenario with resolved config, validated service/profile/env references and the original saved result; no other scenario changes.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

families.special_rules: A validated cmd.docker.compose.scenario.save commits one scenario in the exact Project container_manager.project_state.{project_id}. It records the saved object, not merely opening the save sheet or dispatch acceptance.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: Read one genuine created schedule result with the exact target and original source edition, preserving grace and occurrence identity.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

families.special_rules: A cmd.execution_window.create or the atomic cmd.chat.plan.schedule_build transaction creates one exact ExecutionSchedule. Build At never emits a second create command. Window creation alone starts no work.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: Read one genuine invalidated schedule result with the exact target and original source edition, preserving grace and occurrence identity.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.
A genuine target-already-invalidated result preserves the exact original nonempty reason text without narrowing or translating its domain.

families.special_rules: The Scheduling owner records its existing target-deleted, target-cancelled, target-already-invalidated or exact-version-change invalidation result, preserving the exact original nonempty invalidated_reason without a local reason-code translation. The invalidated record retains its exact former target and reason; it never binds latest or retries a dead target. This is the window-side fact distinct from Assistant Plan’s version-change fact.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: Read one genuine updated schedule result with the exact target and original source edition, preserving grace and occurrence identity.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

families.special_rules: An accepted cmd.execution_window.update changes the original schedule against its expected revision. Narrowing an in-flight window takes effect at the next safe wind-down boundary; it never interrupts an atomic write or silently changes admission.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: A host evaluates an unfinished Goal with a genuine next attempt and unchanged epoch; also plan an independently valid complete case backed by caller evidence.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

families.special_rules: One host evaluation at a continuation boundary records continue/complete/pause/blocked/cancelled, the exact Goal revision, owning run, next attempt and observed user_stop_epoch. Continue requires unfinished objective, eligible thread, runnable attempt and unchanged Stop epoch again at dispatch; complete requires genuine caller-owned completion evidence. This event neither schedules a second turn nor mutates Goal body. Use the existing idempotency tuple (goal_id, goal_revision, owning_run_id, next_attempt_ref), with canonical explicit null for no next attempt; a reevaluation after a genuine owner-state change is a distinct original decision, never a retry.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: One exact Project+NamedPlan original archived result with unchanged child runtime; duplicate display names in the Project are independently valid.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

families.special_rules: cmd.named_plan.archive commits active to archived. Active child work requires the existing explicit warning/confirmation and preserve_unchanged disposition; no child is cancelled or deleted.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: One exact Project+NamedPlan original child_refs_changed result with unchanged child runtime; duplicate display names in the Project are independently valid.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

families.special_rules: NamedPlanOwner::commit_child_refs commits an actual current/historical edge change from a genuine child-owner publication at a consistent snapshot. NPLAN-006 validates child kind/ref/revision/hash and Project+NamedPlan parent edges; preserve historical refs and zero-or-one current primary PRD. No bare focus, opaque ref, history read or lifecycle claim proves a join.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: One exact Project+NamedPlan original created result with unchanged child runtime; duplicate display names in the Project are independently valid.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

families.special_rules: cmd.named_plan.create atomically commits the minimal revision-1 shell, Project membership, thread group and creation receipt. No child runtime is created; duplicate names are allowed and never merge identity.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: One exact Project+NamedPlan original priority_changed result with unchanged child runtime; duplicate display names in the Project are independently valid.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

families.special_rules: cmd.named_plan.set_priority commits an actual change among low/normal/high/urgent; scheduling owners may consume it but retain scheduling authority. Unchanged priority emits nothing.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: One exact Project+NamedPlan original renamed result with unchanged child runtime; duplicate display names in the Project are independently valid.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

families.special_rules: cmd.named_plan.rename commits an actual human-name change against aggregate revision/currentness. named_plan_id, Project and all child refs/approval/runtime state remain unchanged; an identical name emits nothing.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: One exact Project+NamedPlan original restored result with unchanged child runtime; duplicate display names in the Project are independently valid.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: User changes the selected Project latch off to on; separately use genuine application Server source with null Project and no fake thread/Computer request fields.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

families.special_rules: Only an authorized user’s real absolute-value change of the named Project or app/Server pause emits once. Same-value set returns the unchanged original result, no event/revision/epoch change. The original source supplies paused, user_stop_epoch, actor and changed time: true advances the selected scope epoch, false clears only that scope and preserves per-run Stop. No Settings default, missing-as-off, automatic clear, no-op event or backlog dispatch. Project request still has no expected_revision; application uses its existing internal whole-value CAS and unavailable/null-pause branch.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

families.special_rules: The server Scheduling owner records each genuine quota-resume eligibility decision, including refusal and its exact failed clauses; this is an attempt, never an assertion that work ran. Revalidate SQR-006 at decision and final dispatch; a pre-Stop decision delivered afterwards refuses. Accepted eligibility resumes only the same unfinished binding and never redoes committed work.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: Use a genuine quota_resume_consent_changed original source with exact route; separately cover unknown reset truth with no fabricated reset time.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

families.special_rules: cmd.runtime.quota_resume.set commits the actual opt-in consent change scoped to run/provider/account; enabled defaults false only at genuine creation, never by a new global Settings write. Record exact reset truth and source; unchanged consent is no change. Stop/pause remains higher priority and consent never clears it.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: Use a genuine quota_wait_started original source with exact route; separately cover unknown reset truth with no fabricated reset time.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

families.special_rules: Provider usage exhaustion places an existing unfinished run into the shared quota wait. Record the genuine run wait entry and reset truth; unknown stays unknown and a local estimate never becomes provider fact. Goal remains active and Plan remains Building; there is no Goal/To-Do blocked transition merely because of quota.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: Use one exact frozen message snapshot and genuine cancelled result; no client timer or focused-chat substitution.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

families.special_rules: cmd.chat.schedule_message.cancel makes a pending scheduled/held dispatch cancelled; retain the snapshot for audit and never dispatch it. Cancellation is terminal for that pending snapshot; it is not a Stop command for already admitted work.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: Use one exact frozen message snapshot and genuine created result; no client timer or focused-chat substitution.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

families.special_rules: cmd.chat.schedule_message freezes exactly the Schedule Message sheet’s text, attachments, destination and chosen runtime/model/account route in one durable snapshot. Empty sheet text fails regardless of composer text. Commit acknowledges the snapshot and starts no run, Goal, Plan or To-Do.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: Use one exact frozen message snapshot and genuine dispatched result; no client timer or focused-chat substitution.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

families.special_rules: The server timer/explicit Send now path records the original successful owner dispatch receipt after both eligibility checks and exact snapshot admission. Carry the original dispatch idempotency identity and revalidation result. It proves dispatch, never response/build completion. Duplicate timer or restart returns the original result without sending again.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: Use one exact frozen message snapshot and genuine failed result; no client timer or focused-chat substitution.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

families.special_rules: The server Scheduling owner records a genuine failed dispatch result with its original typed failure/reason. It never records ordinary hold as failure, success exit code as failure, or success-shaped run admission for a refused operation. Missing or uncertain original outcome is unavailable and never a fresh send.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: Use one exact frozen message snapshot and genuine held result; no client timer or focused-chat substitution.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.

families.special_rules: The server Scheduling owner records entry into held with the exact failed clause or saved missed-time hold decision. The pending exact snapshot stays unchanged. Project/application pause remains distinct and unknown custody is unavailable, never off. Re-observing the same hold is no new change.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: Use one exact frozen message snapshot and genuine updated result; no client timer or focused-chat substitution.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

Send now is reschedule_to now for this one user dispatch only; scope pause remains on and every other predicate still applies. No implicit destination or route substitution.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: A validated created result in one current thread, preserving exact item identity and all unaffected edges/work; a separate valid application thread uses null Project.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.

Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

families.special_rules: ToDoController validates a proposal and atomically creates one new pending TodoItemV2 in the sole thread-local list. Stable item identity and graph edges are checked first; no cross-thread aggregation or whole-list model authority.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: A validated dependency_changed result in one current thread, preserving exact item identity and all unaffected edges/work; a separate valid application thread uses null Project.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

Compound owner mutation derives its complete component set from actual before/after facts, commits journals atomically and publishes one complete SP-347 group before dependent complete-history acknowledgement.

positives: A validated removed_from_current_list result in one current thread, preserving exact item identity and all unaffected edges/work; a separate valid application thread uses null Project.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

Compound owner mutation derives its complete component set from actual before/after facts, commits journals atomically and publishes one complete SP-347 group before dependent complete-history acknowledgement.

families.special_rules: ToDoController commits exactly one individually receipted TodoTransition per actual status change. Cause is one of the eight existing values. Completion requires item-level accepted outcome evidence (including conversational outcome, not necessarily a tool receipt); tool success alone is insufficient. Parent rollup uses current required children; dependency wait is pending, and quota wait leaves admitted in_progress work in_progress. Bulk completion without each item’s proof fails atomically.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

positives: A validated updated result in one current thread, preserving exact item identity and all unaffected edges/work; a separate valid application thread uses null Project.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

Compound owner mutation derives its complete component set from actual before/after facts, commits journals atomically and publishes one complete SP-347 group before dependent complete-history acknowledgement.

positives: A validated work_bound result in one current thread, preserving exact item identity and all unaffected edges/work; a separate valid application thread uses null Project.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Exactly 16 KiB inline body; larger valid resolved payload through SP-337; measure the complete publication value too.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

Compound owner mutation derives its complete component set from actual before/after facts, commits journals atomically and publishes one complete SP-347 group before dependent complete-history acknowledgement.

families.special_rules: ToDoController attaches the genuine TodoWorkBinding of one admitted leaf with exact work_id/attempt_id, expected outcome and owner admission receipt. Never infer binding from a title, hint, source note or provider status. Any resulting real status transition has its own TodoTransition and todo.status_changed.
families.coverage_rule: At phase 2 expand every listed multi-form family to one record per primitive predicate; no combined negative or unproven duplicate set. Resolve every $ref eagerly, including unvisited branches. Derive a complete assertion inventory from the actual checker and schema, not this prose list alone.

negative_layer_policy: Schema-only negatives test one field/predicate before source/envelope validation. Runtime negatives use entirely schema-valid data and isolate one independent relation; no schema-invalid value doubles as a source mismatch test. The shared tool must prove actual predicate/site cuts at phase 2.
